articles.title_en: Spillover effects of specialized high schools
articles.title_cn: 专业高中的溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: Specialized high schools are an increasingly popular way to prepare young adults for postsecondary experiences and expand school choice. While much literature examines charter school spillover effects and the effects of specialized schools on the students who attend them, little is known about the spillover effects of specialized high schools on traditional public schools (TPS). Using an event study design, we show that one type of specialized high school, North Carolina’s Cooperative Innovative High Schools, initially attracted students who were higher achieving and more likely to be white than TPS students, but these specialized schools became more representative of the district population over time. On average, the opening of specialized schools had a mix of null and positive spillover effects on TPS student achievement. While there is some evidence of negative spillovers from the first schools that opened, the effects become more positive over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 专业高中是为年轻人准备高等教育经历和扩大学校选择的一种日益流行的方式。虽然大量文献考察了特许学校的溢出效应以及专业学校对就读学生的影响，但关于专业高中对传统公立学校（TPS）的溢出效应知之甚少。使用事件研究设计，我们表明一种类型的专业高中，即北卡罗来纳州的合作创新高中，最初吸引的学生比TPS学生成绩更高且更可能是白人，但这些专业学校随着时间的推移变得更加代表地区人口。平均而言，专业学校的开设对TPS学生成绩产生了零效应和正溢出效应的混合。虽然有一些证据表明最早开设的学校产生了负面溢出效应，但随着时间的推移，这些效应变得更加积极。

articles.title_en: The safety net and job loss: How much insurance do public programs provide?
articles.title_cn: 安全网与失业：公共项目提供了多少保险？
articles.abstract_en: We comprehensively evaluate the role of the U.S. safety net in replacing displaced workers’ lost income and health insurance using the 1996–2013 Survey of Income and Program Participation. Cash and near-cash programs replace 32% of lost income on average over the two years following job loss and reduce the likelihood of experiencing poverty by 18 percentage points. 97% of transfer benefits paid in these two years come from Unemployment Insurance. Two years after job loss, the replacement rate is 28%, but this is largely driven by UI benefit extensions unique to the Great Recession. Public health insurance makes up for 17% of the loss in private insurance, but, even two years later, rates of uninsurance are higher than pre-job loss. Looking at heterogeneous effects, in general, the safety net is progressive, though we uncover important gaps in benefits for some disadvantaged groups.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用1996-2013年收入和项目参与调查，全面评估了美国安全网在替代失业工人收入损失和医疗保险方面的作用。现金和近现金项目在失业后两年内平均替代了32%的收入损失，并将经历贫困的可能性降低了18个百分点。在这两年中支付的转移支付中，97%来自失业保险。失业两年后，替代率为28%，但这主要归因于大衰退特有的失业保险福利延长。公共医疗保险弥补了私人保险损失的17%，但即使在两年后，无保险率仍高于失业前。考察异质性效应时，总体而言，安全网具有累进性，尽管我们发现一些弱势群体在福利方面存在重要缺口。

articles.title_en: Coordinated selection of collective action: Wealthy-interest bias and inequality
articles.title_cn: 集体行动的协调选择：富人利益偏差与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We extend a collective action problem to study policy and project selection by heterogeneous groups who prefer to work together on a joint initiative but may disagree on which initiative is best. Our framework, adapted from a model of multiple threshold public goods, presents groups with several mutually exclusive projects, any of which require sufficient support from the group to succeed. Individuals strictly prefer to contribute where and how much they believe others expect of them to ensure joint project success. Groups tend to coordinate on the public good preferred by the wealthiest member, demonstrating a wealthy-interest bias even without corruption, politics, and information asymmetries. At the same time, groups divide costs in highly progressive ways, with the wealthy voluntarily funding a disproportionate share, helping offset the inherent inequality from endowment and selection differences. We discuss applications for policy selection, charitable giving, and taxes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们扩展了一个集体行动问题，以研究异质性群体在政策与项目选择上的行为，这些群体倾向于在联合倡议上合作，但可能对哪个倡议最佳存在分歧。我们的框架改编自一个多阈值公共品模型，向群体呈现多个互斥项目，其中任何一个项目都需要获得群体内足够的支持才能成功。个体严格偏好于在他们认为他人期望他们贡献的地方和数量上进行贡献，以确保联合项目的成功。群体倾向于协调于最富有成员偏好的公共品，即使在不存在腐败、政治和信息不对称的情况下，也表现出富人利益偏差。同时，群体以高度累进的方式分摊成本，富人自愿承担不成比例的份额，这有助于抵消禀赋和选择差异所固有的不平等。我们讨论了在政策选择、慈善捐赠和税收方面的应用。

articles.title_en: The McMansion effect: Positional externalities in U.S. suburbs
articles.title_cn: 麦克豪宅效应：美国郊区的地位外部性
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how the construction of very large homes — or “McMansions” — in U.S. suburbs affects homeowners’ satisfaction and housing behavior. Combining three decades of survey data with geolocated information on three million suburban houses, I find that homeowners exposed to newly constructed, large houses report lower satisfaction with their own homes, while their neighborhood satisfaction remains unaffected. This effect is contingent on the visual salience of McMansions, as indicated by their proximity to roads. Homeowners exposed to new-built McMansions are more likely to expand their own homes and take on more debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了美国郊区建造超大型住宅——即“麦克豪宅”——如何影响房主的满意度和住房行为。结合三十年的调查数据以及三百万套郊区住宅的地理定位信息，我发现，接触到新建大型住宅的房主对自己住房的满意度较低，而他们对社区的满意度则不受影响。这一效应取决于麦克豪宅的视觉显著性，如其与道路的邻近程度所示。接触到新建麦克豪宅的房主更有可能扩建自己的住房并承担更多债务。

articles.title_en: The effects of physician vertical integration on referral patterns, patient welfare, and market dynamics
articles.title_cn: 医生纵向整合对转诊模式、患者福利和市场动态的影响
articles.abstract_en: The growth of physician vertical integration raises concerns about distorted referral patterns, higher spending, and market foreclosure. Using 100% Medicare data, we combine reduced-form analysis with a discrete choice model to estimate the effects of physician vertical integration on patients’ provider choices and welfare for two common “downstream” surgical procedures. Physician–hospital integration results in an approximately 10% increase in referrals to higher-priced facilities instead of lower-priced providers. Our counterfactual analysis implies that if all primary care physicians become integrated, total Medicare spending will increase by $315 million.
articles.abstract_cn: 医生纵向整合的增长引发了对转诊模式扭曲、支出增加和市场封锁的担忧。利用100%的医疗保险数据，我们将简化形式分析与离散选择模型相结合，评估医生纵向整合对患者为两种常见“下游”外科手术选择医疗服务提供者及其福利的影响。医生与医院的整合导致转向高价医疗机构的转诊增加约10%%，而非转向低价提供者。我们的反事实分析表明，如果所有初级保健医生都实现整合，医疗保险总支出将增加$315百万。

articles.title_en: School segregation in the presence of student sorting and cream-skimming: Evidence from a school voucher reform
articles.title_cn: 存在学生分流和择优录取情况下的学校隔离：来自学校代金券改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses a reform to Chile’s school choice system to study student socioeconomic segregation with a focus on student demand and school selectivity. The reform increases the subsidies that schools receive for low socioeconomic status students. I exploit this shock to schools’ incentives to test for selection at admission based on students’ socioeconomic characteristics. Schools respond to the new voucher by decreasing the level of cream-skimming. I incorporate these admission restrictions in a demand model to estimate parents’ preferences for school and peer characteristics. I show that ignoring admission restrictions leads to underestimating poor parents’ preferences for school quality. Counterfactual simulations show that preferences of high-SES parents for high-SES peers are one of the main drivers behind segregation as opposed to schools’ selective behavior. This likely explains the unexpected increase in enrollment for schools that opted out of the reform and the ineffectiveness of the reform in reducing socioeconomic segregation across schools.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用智利学校选择体系的改革来研究学生社会经济隔离，重点关注学生需求和学校选择性。改革提高了学校招收社会经济地位较低学生所获得的补贴。我利用这一冲击学校激励的机会，检验入学时基于学生社会经济特征的选择性。学校通过降低择优录取水平来回应新的代金券。我将这些入学限制纳入需求模型，以估计家长对学校和同伴特征的偏好。我表明，忽略入学限制会导致低估贫困家长对学校质量的偏好。反事实模拟显示，高社会经济地位家长对高社会经济地位同伴的偏好是隔离的主要驱动因素之一，而非学校的选择性行为。这很可能解释了选择退出改革的学校入学人数的意外增加，以及改革在减少学校间社会经济隔离方面的无效性。

articles.title_en: Do bishops matter for politics? Evidence From Italy
articles.title_cn: 主教对政治有影响吗？来自意大利的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies whether and how religious leaders affect politics. Focusing on Italian dioceses in the period from 1948 to 1992, we find that the identity of the bishop in office explains a significant amount of the variation in the vote share for the Christian Democracy party (DC). This result is robust to several exercises that use different samples and time windows. Zooming into the mechanism, we find that two characteristics of bishops matter: (i) his political culture, and (ii) his interaction with the population—the latter being measured using text-analysis techniques.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究宗教领袖是否以及如何影响政治。以1948年至1992年期间的意大利教区为研究对象，我们发现任职主教的身份解释了基督教民主党（DC）选票份额变异的很大一部分。这一结果在采用不同样本和时间窗口的多次检验中均保持稳健。深入机制分析，我们发现主教的两个特征至关重要：（i）其政治文化，以及（ii）其与民众的互动——后者通过文本分析技术进行衡量。

articles.title_en: The political economy of coastal development
articles.title_cn: 沿海发展的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: Coastal development has advantages, such as job creation, and drawbacks, such as the loss of environmental amenities, for both residents and non-residents. Local governments may prioritize their constituents’ interests, resulting in suboptimal coastal development. We investigate how political alignment among neighboring mayors facilitates intergovernmental cooperation in the development of coastal areas. We leverage causal effects by applying a close-elections Regression Discontinuity Design to the universe of buildings in Spain. Municipalities with party-aligned mayors develop 46% less land than politically isolated ones, and politically homogeneous coastal areas develop less than fragmented ones. The effect is more salient for land closest to shore or previously occupied by forests, in municipalities with a large share of protected land, and for relevant environmental markers, such as air and bathing water pollution. These results underscore the importance of cooperative political endeavors in managing development spillovers, with environmental considerations assuming a central role.
articles.abstract_cn: 沿海发展既有优势，如创造就业，也有弊端，如环境资源的丧失，对居民和非居民均是如此。地方政府可能优先考虑其选民的利益，导致沿海发展欠佳。我们研究了相邻市长之间的政治一致性如何促进沿海地区开发中的政府间合作。我们通过将接近选举的断点回归设计应用于西班牙的所有建筑，来利用因果效应。拥有党派一致市长的城市比政治孤立的城市少开发46%的土地，而政治同质的沿海地区比碎片化的地区开发更少。这一效应在离海岸最近或先前被森林覆盖的土地上、在保护区土地占比较大的城市中，以及对于空气和沐浴水污染等相关环境指标更为显著。这些结果强调了合作政治努力在管理开发溢出效应中的重要性，其中环境考量扮演着核心角色。

articles.title_en: Organizational capacity and profit shifting
articles.title_cn: 组织能力与利润转移
articles.abstract_en: Good organizational capacity drives productivity and potential taxable profits, but may also enable multinationals (MNEs) to more efficiently re-allocate profits across tax jurisdictions, lowering actual taxable profits. We show that MNE subsidiaries with better organizational capacity report significantly lower profits in high-tax countries. This pattern is not present in low-tax countries. Further, responsiveness to corporate tax rate changes in terms of profit reporting is driven by firms with good organizational capacity. We show our results are consistent with profit-shifting behavior and rule out key alternative channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 良好的组织能力能提升生产力和潜在应税利润，但也可能使跨国企业（MNEs）更有效地在税收管辖区之间重新分配利润，从而降低实际应税利润。我们表明，组织能力较强的跨国企业子公司在高税收国家报告的利润显著较低。这一模式在低税收国家并不存在。此外，就利润报告而言，对企业所得税税率变化的响应性由组织能力良好的企业驱动。我们证明我们的结果与利润转移行为一致，并排除了关键替代渠道。

articles.title_en: Public pensions and retirement: Evidence from the Railroad Retirement Act
articles.title_cn: 公共养老金与退休：来自《铁路退休法》的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates how public pensions affect retirement timing by examining the Railroad Retirement Act of 1937, which replaced private railroad pensions with a national program comparable in many ways to Social Security. Leveraging linked decennial census records between 1910–1940, the first part of the analysis compares male labor force nonparticipation in 1940 relative to 1930, between workers previously in railroad versus other industries with broad pension coverage, and by age. Higher benefits led to earlier retirement, largely driven by exit at age 65. The second part of my analysis also exploits the switch from flat to progressive benefits in average wages to estimate the elasticity of nonparticipation with respect to benefits for men aged 65-69. My central estimate of 0.55 indicates a large retirement response. Application of these estimates to Social Security expansions in the 1950s suggests rising benefits was the key driver of earlier retirement among the already-insured male population during this era.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察1937年《铁路退休法》（该法案用一项在许多方面与社会保障相当的国家计划取代了私人铁路养老金）来估计公共养老金如何影响退休时机。利用1910-1940年间的关联十年一次人口普查记录，分析的第一部分比较了1940年相对于1930年，先前在铁路行业与其他养老金覆盖广泛行业的男性劳动力不参与率，并按年龄分组。更高的福利导致更早退休，主要由65岁时的退出驱动。我分析的第二部分还利用从平均工资的固定福利转向累进福利的变化，来估计65-69岁男性不参与率对福利的弹性。我的中心估计值为0.55，表明退休反应显著。将这些估计应用于1950年代社会保障扩张，表明福利增加是该时期已参保男性人口更早退休的关键驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Optional (non-)filing and effective taxation
articles.title_cn: 可选（不）申报与有效税收
articles.abstract_en: Many countries have automatic wage tax withholding systems with tax non-filing options for some taxpayers. We show that this has sizable and potentially unintended implications for effective taxation because taxes are often over-withheld. Low-income taxpayers pay more taxes than they have to because they frequently do not file. Using German administrative tax data, we document that the average non-filer overpays €119 in one year, equivalent to a 1.2 percentage point increase in the average tax rate. Non-filing acts as a form of “reverse evasion”: It weakens the effective tax progressivity by increasing tax rates at the bottom of the income distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家实行自动工资预扣税制度，部分纳税人可选择不进行税务申报。我们表明，这会对有效税收产生显著且可能非预期的后果，因为税款往往被多预扣。低收入纳税人由于经常不申报而缴纳了超过应缴的税款。利用德国行政税收数据，我们记录了平均不申报者一年内多缴€119，相当于平均税率提高1.2个百分点。不申报行为构成一种“反向逃税”：它通过提高收入分布底端的税率，削弱了有效税收的累进性。

articles.title_en: Heard the news? Environmental policy and clean investments
articles.title_cn: 听到消息了吗？环境政策与清洁投资
articles.abstract_en: We build the first news-based index of US environmental and climate policy and examine how it relates to clean investments. Extracting text from ten leading US newspapers over the last four decades, we use text-mining techniques to develop a granular news index of US environmental and climate policy (EnvP) over the 1981–2019 period. Furthermore, we develop a set of additional measures, namely an index of sentiment on environmental policy, as well as various topic-specific indexes. We validate our index by showing that it correctly captures trends and peaks in the evolution of US environmental and climate policy and that it has a meaningful association with clean investments, in line with environmental regulations supporting growing opportunities for clean markets. In firm-level estimations, we find that our index is associated with a greater probability of receiving venture capital (VC) funding for cleantech startups and reduced stock returns for high-emissions firms most exposed to environmental regulations. At the aggregate level, we find in VAR models that a shock in our news-based index of renewable energy policy is associated with an increase in the number of clean energy VC deals and in the assets under management of a benchmark clean energy exchange-traded fund.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了首个基于新闻的美国环境和气候政策指数，并考察其与清洁投资的关系。通过提取过去四十年间美国十家主要报纸的文本，我们运用文本挖掘技术，开发了一个涵盖1981-2019年期间的美国环境和气候政策（EnvP）的细粒度新闻指数。此外，我们还制定了一套附加指标，即环境政策情绪指数，以及各种特定主题指数。我们通过展示该指数正确捕捉了美国环境和气候政策演变中的趋势和峰值，并证明其与清洁投资存在有意义的关联，这与环境法规支持清洁市场增长机会相一致，从而验证了我们的指数。在企业层面的估计中，我们发现该指数与清洁技术初创企业获得风险投资（VC）资金的可能性增加以及受环境法规影响最大的高排放企业股票回报率下降相关。在总体层面，我们在VAR模型中发现，基于新闻的可再生能源政策指数的冲击与清洁能源风险投资交易数量的增加以及基准清洁能源交易所交易基金管理资产的增加相关。

articles.title_en: Norm-based feedback on household waste: Large-scale field experiments in two Swedish municipalities
articles.title_cn: 基于规范的垃圾反馈：瑞典两个市镇的大规模实地实验
articles.abstract_en: We conduct two large-scale randomized controlled trials to produce the first evidence that Home Energy Report-type norm feedback letters can be used to reduce household waste. We explore several feedback variants, including a novel short-run dynamic norm that emphasizes ongoing changes in waste behavior. Waste reductions are on the order of 7%–12% for all treatments, substantially larger than usually found in the energy or water domains. Effects are mostly driven by increased recycling of packaging and remain largely intact a year after the intervention ended. Feedback is highly cost-effective compared to alternative non-price waste policies. However, net social benefits depend on household preferences for receiving feedback, which we elicit in a valuation survey, and whether existing waste fees internalize the marginal social cost of waste.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了两项大规模随机对照试验，首次提供证据表明家庭能源报告类型的规范反馈信可用于减少家庭垃圾。我们探索了几种反馈变体，包括一种新颖的短期动态规范，强调垃圾行为的持续变化。所有处理组的垃圾减少量约为7%–12%，远大于通常在能源或水领域发现的减少量。效果主要由包装回收增加驱动，并在干预结束一年后基本保持。与替代的非价格垃圾政策相比，反馈具有很高的成本效益。然而，净社会效益取决于家庭对接收反馈的偏好（我们在估值调查中引出）以及现有垃圾费是否内化了垃圾的边际社会成本。

articles.title_en: Later-life mortality and the repeal of federal prohibition
articles.title_cn: 晚年死亡率与联邦禁酒令的废除
articles.abstract_en: Despite a recent and dramatic re-evaluation of the health consequences of alcohol consumption, very little is known about the effects of in utero exposure to alcohol on long-run outcomes such as later-life mortality. Here, we investigate how state by year variation in alcohol control arising from the repeal of federal prohibition affects mortality for cohorts born in the 1930s. We find that individuals born in wet states experienced higher later-life mortality than individuals born in dry states, translating into a 3.3% increase in mortality rates between 1990 and 2004 for affected cohorts.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管近期对饮酒健康后果的评估发生了戏剧性的重新审视，但关于子宫内酒精暴露对长期结果（如晚年死亡率）的影响知之甚少。在此，我们研究了因废除联邦禁酒令而产生的州际逐年酒精控制变化如何影响1930年出生队列的死亡率。我们发现，出生在湿州的个体晚年死亡率高于出生在干州的个体，这转化为受影响队列在1990年至2004年间死亡率增加3.3%。

articles.title_en: Spillovers in fields of study: Siblings, cousins, and neighbors
articles.title_cn: 专业选择中的溢出效应：兄弟姐妹、堂表亲与邻居
articles.abstract_en: We use admission lotteries for higher education studies in the Netherlands to investigate whether someone’s field of study influences the study choices of their younger peers. We find that younger siblings and cousins are strongly affected. Also younger neighbors are affected but to a smaller extent. These findings indicate that a substantial part of the correlations in study choices between family members can be attributed to spillover effects and are not due to shared environments. Our findings concur with those of recent studies based on admission thresholds, which find sibling spillovers on college or college-major choices. This indicates that the results from previous studies can be extrapolated to students away from admission thresholds, and from siblings to cousins and neighbors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰高等教育录取抽签来研究某人的专业选择是否会影响其较年幼同伴的学习选择。我们发现，较年幼的兄弟姐妹和堂表亲受到强烈影响。较年幼的邻居也受到影响，但程度较小。这些发现表明，家庭成员之间学习选择的相关性有很大一部分可归因于溢出效应，而非共同环境所致。我们的发现与近期基于录取分数线的研究结果一致，这些研究发现兄弟姐妹在学院或学院专业选择上存在溢出效应。这表明，先前研究的结果可以推广到远离录取分数线的学生，以及从兄弟姐妹推广到堂表亲和邻居。

articles.title_en: Estimating intergenerational health transmission in Taiwan with administrative health records
articles.title_cn: 利用行政健康记录估计台湾的代际健康传递
articles.abstract_en: We use population-wide administrative health records from Taiwan to estimate intergenerational persistence in health, providing the first estimates for a middle-income country. We measure latent health by applying principal components analysis to a set of indicators for 13 broad ICD categories and quintiles of visits to a general practitioner. We find that the rank–rank slope in health between adult children and their parents is 0.22 which is broadly in line with results from other countries. Maternal transmission is stronger than paternal transmission and sons have higher persistence than daughters. Persistence is also higher at the upper tail of the parent health distribution. Persistence is lower when complete data on outpatient care is unavailable. Health transmission is almost entirely unrelated to household income levels in Taiwan. We also find that there are small geographic differences in absolute health mobility across townships and that these are modestly correlated with area-level income and doctor availability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用台湾全人口行政健康记录来估计健康的代际持续性，提供了首个中等收入国家的估计。我们通过对13个宽泛的ICD类别和全科医生就诊次数的五分位数指标进行主成分分析来衡量潜在健康。我们发现成年子女与其父母之间的健康秩-秩斜率为0.22，与其他国家的结果大致一致。母系传递强于父系传递，儿子的持续性高于女儿。在父母健康分布的上尾，持续性也更高。当门诊护理的完整数据不可用时，持续性较低。在台湾，健康传递与家庭收入水平几乎完全无关。我们还发现，各乡镇之间的绝对健康流动性存在较小的地理差异，并且这些差异与地区收入和医生可用性适度相关。

articles.title_en: Rounded Up: Using round numbers to identify tax evasion
articles.title_cn: 凑整：利用整数来识别逃税行为
articles.abstract_en: Australian taxpayers display a clear preference for round numbers for end-of-year tax refunds, bunching at positive and salient thresholds such as the tens, hundreds and thousands. Bunching appears to be driven by tax evasion. Data from audited returns shows that bunching is present in returns before audit, but does not persist post-audit. Tax preparers play an important role, being twice as likely to deliver positive round-number refunds as individuals who file their own tax returns. Preparers with greater propensity to bunch deliver larger refunds by lifting deductions and lowering reported income for return items where audits are costly. This highlights how bunching behaviors can help identify tax evasion, including tax preparers who facilitate it and the tax return items which are manipulated.
articles.abstract_cn: 澳大利亚纳税人在年终退税时明显偏好整数，集中在正数且显著的阈值上，如十位、百位和千位。这种聚集现象似乎是由逃税驱动的。来自审计后申报表的数据显示，聚集现象在审计前的申报表中存在，但在审计后不再持续。税务代理人在其中扮演重要角色，他们提供正数整数退税的可能性是自行申报纳税人的两倍。那些更倾向于凑整的代理人通过提高扣除额和降低报告收入来提供更大的退税，尤其是在审计成本较高的申报项目上。这凸显了聚集行为如何有助于识别逃税行为，包括协助逃税的税务代理人以及被操纵的申报项目。

articles.title_en: Sophistication about self-control
articles.title_cn: 关于自我控制的复杂性
articles.abstract_en: We use information on people’s ideal, predicted, and realized body weight to classify them as time-consistent versus naïve, and partially or fully sophisticated regarding their self-control limitations. Operationalizing this approach in population-representative data reveals that self-control problems are pervasive and that most people are at least partly aware of their limited self-control. Compared to naïfs, sophisticates have higher IQs, better educated parents, and are more likely to use potential commitment devices. Despite their self-control problems, sophisticated individuals make similar choices as time-consistent individuals when those choices involve immediate costs and later benefits. An increased awareness of one’s own self-control limitations may thus help in reducing their adverse consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用人们理想、预测和实际体重的信息，将他们分类为时间一致型与天真型，以及部分或完全了解自身自我控制限制的复杂型。在具有人口代表性的数据中实施这一方法揭示，自我控制问题普遍存在，且大多数人至少部分意识到自己的自我控制有限。与天真型相比，复杂型个体具有更高的智商、受过更好教育的父母，并且更可能使用潜在的承诺机制。尽管存在自我控制问题，复杂型个体在涉及即时成本和后期收益的选择中，会做出与时间一致型个体相似的选择。因此，增强对自身自我控制限制的认识可能有助于减少其不利后果。

articles.title_en: Brains versus brawn: Ordinal rank effects in job training
articles.title_cn: 智力与体力：职业培训中的序数排名效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes ordinal rank across cognitive and physical ability within an initial job training program. Using a rich administrative dataset and conditional random assignment of trainees to peer groups, we test whether rank effects vary across contemporaneous training and long-term career outcomes. We find cognitive ordinal rank, measured by an individual’s score on the Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT), has a meaningful impact on completing initial training into the U.S. Air Force (USAF). This ranking also affects occupational specialization for trainees that arrive without a preassigned occupation. We also show physical ordinal rank, measured by an individual’s initial fitness score, affects job training performance. Both sets of ranking effects impact behavioral misconduct outcomes and vary by gender. Finally, the interaction between cognitive and physical ordinal ranking has multiplicative effects on a limited set of outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了初始职业培训项目中认知和体能能力的序数排名。利用丰富的行政数据集和受训者随机分配到同伴组的条件随机分配，我们检验了排名效应是否在同期培训和长期职业结果中有所不同。我们发现，以个人在武装部队资格测验（AFQT）中的分数衡量的认知序数排名，对完成美国空军（USAF）初始培训有显著影响。这种排名也影响没有预先分配职业的受训者的职业专业化。我们还表明，以个人初始体能分数衡量的体能序数排名，影响职业培训表现。两组排名效应都影响行为不当结果，并因性别而异。最后，认知和体能序数排名之间的交互作用对有限的结果集具有乘数效应。

articles.title_en: Softening the blow: Job retention schemes in the pandemic
articles.title_cn: 缓解冲击：疫情中的职位保留计划
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the welfare effects of the temporary job retention schemes (JRS) implemented in response to the COVID-19 pandemic in a DSGE model with incomplete insurance and heterogeneous agents calibrated to the euro area. JRS have large favorable welfare effects and benefit all households when they are well targeted at potentially viable jobs at risk of being lost. These gains are particularly strong for liquid-asset-poor households, especially for those that are also unemployed or on furlough. The job protection component of JRS explains almost all the welfare gains they deliver, while their high level of generosity plays a minor role and has ambiguous net aggregate welfare effects. We also discuss the conditions that make JRS valuable and show that they can cause a decrease in welfare when they subsidize too many safe jobs; when they are targeted at non-viable jobs that will inevitably be lost once schemes end; and when implemented in economies where labor market frictions are low.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了为应对COVID-19大流行而实施的临时职位保留计划（JRS）在具有不完全保险和异质性主体的DSGE模型中的福利效应，该模型校准至欧元区。当JRS精准针对可能流失但具有潜在可行性的工作岗位时，它们具有显著的正面福利效应，并使所有家庭受益。这些收益对流动性资产匮乏的家庭尤为显著，特别是对那些同时失业或被强制休假（furlough）的家庭。JRS的职位保护成分几乎解释了其带来的全部福利收益，而其高水平的慷慨程度作用较小，且对总体福利具有模糊的净效应。我们还讨论了使JRS有价值的条件，并表明当JRS补贴过多安全岗位、针对那些在计划结束后必然流失的不可持续岗位，以及在劳动力市场摩擦较低的经济体中实施时，它们可能导致福利下降。

articles.title_en: The division of parental leave: Empirical evidence and policy design
articles.title_cn: 育儿假的分配：实证证据与政策设计
articles.abstract_en: We study several key aspects of the design of parental leave systems. First, we estimate parents’ willingness to pay for parental leave using Danish administrative data on the division of leave from almost 190,000 births combined with sharp variation in economic incentives created by the parental leave benefit system. We find evidence of both strong behavioral responses with significant bunching at kink points and a willingness to pay for a gender-traditional allocation of leave, where fathers take little or no leave. Second, we provide a menu of counterfactual policy simulations showing substantial interaction effects between earmarked leave, replacement rates and the duration of leave benefits. Relevant for the implementation of a recent EU directive, a higher replacement rate significantly increases the behavioral response of fathers to earmarked leave. Finally, we discuss the welfare effects of different policies aimed at increasing the parental leave of fathers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了育儿假制度设计的几个关键方面。首先，我们利用丹麦行政数据，基于近190,000例出生中育儿假的分配情况，结合育儿假福利制度造成的经济激励的急剧变化，估计了父母对育儿假的支付意愿。我们发现了显著的行为反应证据，包括在拐点处的显著聚集现象，以及父母对性别传统分配育儿假（即父亲很少或完全不休假）的支付意愿。其次，我们提供了一系列反事实政策模拟，显示指定假期、替代率和假期福利持续时间之间存在显著的交互效应。与近期欧盟指令的实施相关，更高的替代率显著增加了父亲对指定假期的行为反应。最后，我们讨论了旨在增加父亲育儿假的不同政策的福利效应。

articles.title_en: The intergenerational (Im)mobility of immigrants
articles.title_cn: 移民的代际（不）流动性
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the influence of pre-migration social background on the long-term economic assimilation of immigrants. I use unique French survey data to trace family histories over three generations, before and after migration. While many immigrants experience an occupational downgrading at migration, their children benefit from various characteristics associated with the high socio-economic status their family had in the origin country. As a result, characteristics of immigrant grandparents are highly predictive of their grandchildren’s educational attainment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了迁移前社会背景对移民长期经济同化的影响。我使用了独特的法国调查数据，追踪了三代人（迁移前后）的家庭历史。尽管许多移民在迁移时经历了职业降级，但他们的子女受益于与其家庭在原籍国所拥有的高社会经济地位相关的各种特征。因此，移民祖父母的特征对其孙辈的教育成就具有高度预测性。

articles.title_en: How do parole boards respond to large, societal shocks? Evidence from the 9/11 terrorist attacks
articles.title_cn: 假释委员会如何应对大规模社会冲击？来自9/11恐怖袭击的证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence of the impact of 9/11 on outcomes for Muslims in the US criminal justice system. We focus on parole outcomes of Black Muslim men in the state of Georgia, and find large post-9/11 declines in the likelihood of being granted parole and a subsequent 23% relative increase in prison time for Muslim inmates. These impacts persisted for several years after 9/11 and were larger for inmates with higher levels of recidivism risk. We argue that these effects reflect unwarranted disparities driven by the decision-making of parole board members post-9/11.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了9/11事件对美国刑事司法系统中穆斯林结果影响的首个证据。我们聚焦于佐治亚州黑人穆斯林男性的假释结果，发现9/11事件后获得假释的可能性大幅下降，随后穆斯林囚犯的监禁时间相对增加了23%。这些影响在9/11事件后持续了数年，并且对于再犯风险较高的囚犯影响更大。我们认为这些效应反映了9/11事件后假释委员会成员决策所导致的不合理差异。

articles.title_en: Effects of the expanded Child Tax Credit on employment outcomes
articles.title_cn: 扩大的儿童税收抵免对就业结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: The temporary 2021 expansion of the Child Tax Credit (CTC) was intended to reduce child poverty during the COVID-19 pandemic. The expansion’s elimination of an existing phase-in with earnings, however, potentially disincentivized labor supply, raising concerns that it would reduce parent employment. We empirically test for employment effects using difference-in-differences analyses with Current Population Survey data. Across many specifications and multiple sub-groups, we find very small, inconsistently signed, statistically insignificant impacts of the 2021 CTC on parental labor force participation and employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 临时性的2021年儿童税收抵免（CTC）扩大旨在减少COVID-19大流行期间的儿童贫困。然而，该扩大取消了现有的收入逐步引入机制，可能抑制劳动力供给，引发其可能减少父母就业的担忧。我们使用当前人口调查数据，通过双重差分分析对就业影响进行实证检验。在许多规格和多个子群体中，我们发现2021年CTC对父母劳动力参与和就业的影响非常小、符号不一致且统计上不显著。

articles.title_en: No country for young people? The rise of anti-immigration politics in ageing societies
articles.title_cn: 没有年轻人的国家？老龄化社会中的反移民政治兴起
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of population ageing on immigration policies using a citizen-candidate model of elections. In each period, young people work and pay taxes while old people receive social security payments. Immigrants are all young, meaning they contribute significantly to financing the cost of public services and social security. Among natives, the elderly and the poor benefit the most from public spending. However, since these two types of voters do not internalise the positive fiscal effects of immigration, they have a common interest in supporting candidates who seek to curb immigration and increase the tax burden on high-income individuals. Population ageing increases the size and, in turn, the political power of such sociodemographic groups, resulting in more restrictive immigration policies, a larger public sector, higher tax rates, and lower societal well-being. Calibrating the model to UK data suggests that the magnitude of these effects is large. The implications of this model are shown to be consistent with the patterns observed in UK attitudinal data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用公民候选人选举模型研究人口老龄化对移民政策的影响。在每个时期，年轻人工作并纳税，而老年人领取社会保障金。移民均为年轻人，这意味着他们对公共服务和社会保障的成本融资有显著贡献。在本地人中，老年人和穷人从公共支出中获益最多。然而，由于这两类选民没有内化移民的积极财政效应，他们共同倾向于支持那些试图限制移民并增加高收入人群税收负担的候选人。人口老龄化增加了此类社会人口群体的规模，进而增强了其政治力量，导致移民政策更加严格、公共部门规模扩大、税率提高以及社会福利水平下降。将模型校准至英国数据表明，这些效应的规模是巨大的。该模型的推论与英国态度数据中观察到的模式一致。
